tutorials.title: Find your way around
tutorials.summary: The four tabs, your dashboard, and the voice guide.

steps.title: Welcome to NCLEX Prep
steps.say: Welcome to NCLEX Prep. Everything in the app lives under four tabs along the bottom of the screen: Home, Learn, Practice and Simulate.

steps.title: Your dashboard
steps.say: Home is your dashboard. The ring shows your overall accuracy. Beside it are your study streak, how many questions you've answered, and how much of the question bank you've covered.

steps.title: Today's plan
steps.say: Below it is Today's plan. Set your test date there, and the app builds a study plan for every day until your exam. The next tutorial shows how.

steps.title: Category mastery
steps.say: Scroll down to Category mastery. Each bar tracks your correct answers in that subject. Tap any category for a quick ten-question quiz on it.

steps.title: Your progress
steps.say: The chart icon at the top opens Your Progress, with your score trend and your recent sessions.

steps.title: Back up your progress
steps.say: Further down, save a backup of everything you've done to a file. If you change phones or reinstall the app, restore it and carry on where you left off.

steps.title: The Learn tab
steps.say: The Learn tab is for studying: flashcards, lab values, visual drug cards and study guides.

steps.title: The Practice tab
steps.say: The Practice tab is where you test yourself, from the Exam Center and your analytics to case studies and drills.

steps.title: The Simulate tab
steps.say: Simulate holds nine animated labs for hands-on skills, like reading heart rhythms and blood gases.

steps.title: Set the speaking speed
steps.say: The app can read aloud as you study. In the Learn tab, open Voice and narration, and slide to set how fast it speaks, from slower to fastest. If you study in a web browser, you can pick which voice reads to you as well.

steps.title: The voice guide
steps.say: Finally, the speaker at the top of every tab switches that narration on and off. Tap it whenever you want quiet, and again when you want the explanations read to you.

tutorials.title: Plan your study
tutorials.summary: Set your test date and follow a day-by-day plan built around your weak areas.

steps.title: Plan your study
steps.say: Start on the Home tab. Under Today's plan, tap Plan your study.

steps.title: Set your test date
steps.say: Tap Set your test date.

steps.title: Pick the date
steps.say: Tap the date, pick your exam day from the calendar, and tap OK.

steps.title: Choose your study days
steps.say: Then choose the days you study. Any day you leave out becomes a rest day.

steps.title: Save your plan
steps.say: Tap Save plan, and your plan appears: your test date, the days left, and about how many questions to answer on each study day.

steps.title: Four phases
steps.say: The colored bar shows the phases. First you build your weak areas, one Client Needs area a day. Then you practice under exam conditions. The final week is lighter, with a full adaptive exam and a rest day before the test.

steps.title: Today's tasks
steps.say: Today's tasks come first. Tap one to start it. Question tasks tick themselves off as you answer; tick the others off yourself.

steps.title: Every day ahead
steps.say: Scroll to see every day until your exam. The plan adjusts each morning to what you've done, so a missed day never piles up.

steps.title: Back on Home
steps.say: Back on Home, Today's plan counts down to your exam and lists today's tasks.

steps.title: Start a task
steps.say: Tap a task to begin. This one opens today's questions.

tutorials.title: Answer your first questions
tutorials.summary: Start a quick quiz, check your answer, and learn from the rationale.

steps.title: Start Quick 10
steps.say: The fastest way to start is Quick 10 on the Home tab. It gives you ten mixed questions in study mode, where you see the rationale straight after each answer.

steps.title: Read the instruction
steps.say: The label above each question tells you how to answer it. The speaker button next to it reads the question aloud.

steps.title: Answer, then Submit
steps.say: Choose your answer, then tap Submit.

steps.title: Read the rationale
steps.say: Green means correct. Read the rationale to learn why. This is where most of your learning happens, so don't skip it, even when you're right.

steps.title: Bookmark and move on
steps.say: Tap the bookmark icon to save a question for later. Then tap Next question.

steps.title: Keep going
steps.say: Answer the next question the same way. Questions with several parts earn partial credit, just like the real exam.

steps.title: Pause any time
steps.say: You can leave with the back arrow whenever you like. Your session is saved, and you can pick it up later under Resume in the Exam Center.

tutorials.title: Figures that explain the answer
tutorials.summary: See the lab ranges, tables and drug drawings that come with the rationales.

steps.title: Open the practice set
steps.say: Many rationales come with a figure that explains the idea at a glance. Let's open a practice set in the Exam Center.

steps.title: Answer the question
steps.say: Answer the question and submit it, as usual.

steps.title: A figure under the rationale
steps.say: Below the rationale is a figure. This one shows where serum potassium becomes dangerous, whether it runs low or high.

steps.title: Tap to hear more
steps.say: Tap any part of a figure to hear it read aloud. Tapping the high zone explains its signs and what to do.

steps.title: The next question
steps.say: Now the next question, about heparin.

steps.title: Tables compare
steps.say: Some figures are tables. This one pairs each anticoagulant with its lab test and its reversal agent.

steps.title: Drug mechanisms
steps.say: When a question names a drug, its animated mechanism appears too. Tap a part of the drawing to learn what it does.

steps.title: Open the drug card
steps.say: And Open the Heparin card takes you straight to the full drug card.

tutorials.title: Every question format
tutorials.summary: How to answer multiple choice, select all, ordering, calculations, and every Next Gen format.

steps.title: Open the Exam Center
steps.say: Let's walk through every question format. On the Practice tab, open the Exam Center. Unfinished sessions wait for you under Resume.

steps.title: Resume a session
steps.say: Tap a session to continue it where you left off.

steps.title: Multiple choice
steps.say: Multiple choice asks for the single best answer. Tap one option, then tap Submit.

steps.title: Select all that apply
steps.say: Select all that apply can have several right answers. Tap every correct option. Each right pick earns a point, and each wrong pick takes one away.

steps.title: Ordered response
steps.say: For ordered response, press and hold a row, then drag it into place. Put every step in order before you submit.

steps.title: Calculation
steps.say: Calculation questions ask you to type a number. Check the rounding instruction in the question, then enter your answer.

steps.title: Matrix grid
steps.say: A matrix needs one choice in every row. For each client, tap the cell under the correct column.

steps.title: Bow-tie
steps.say: A bow-tie has three parts. Choose the condition the client is most likely experiencing, then two actions to take, and two parameters to monitor.

steps.title: Drop-down cloze
steps.say: For drop-down questions, tap each Select box and choose the words that complete the sentence.

steps.title: Highlight
steps.say: Highlight questions ask you to tap the parts of a report or note that matter. Tap a highlight again to remove it.

steps.title: Trend
steps.say: Trend questions show data over time. Read the table from left to right to see what's changing, then answer.

steps.title: See your results
steps.say: On the last question, tap See results for your score and a review of every answer.

tutorials.title: Build a practice exam
tutorials.summary: Set the mode, length, question pool and filters in the Exam Center.

steps.title: Open the Exam Center
steps.say: The Exam Center builds any practice test you need. Open it from the Practice tab.

steps.title: Study or exam mode
steps.say: Study mode shows the rationale after every answer. Exam mode is like test day: timed, one question at a time, with the answers revealed at the end.

steps.title: Choose the length
steps.say: Choose 85 or 150 questions to match the real exam, or Custom to set your own length. Let's make a short ten-question exam.

steps.title: Question pool
steps.say: The question pool lets you focus on questions you haven't seen, ones you got wrong, your bookmarks, or your weak areas.

steps.title: Filters
steps.say: You can narrow it down further by Client Needs category, topic, difficulty and question format.

steps.title: Start the exam
steps.say: The summary shows how many questions match your filters. Tap Start exam.

steps.title: Answer, then Next
steps.say: In exam mode, choose an answer and tap Next. There's no going back, just like the real exam.

steps.title: Flag for review
steps.say: Tap the flag to mark a question you want to revisit in your review, or the bookmark to study it later.

steps.title: Finish the exam
steps.say: Work through the rest. On the last question, Submit exam ends it and opens your results.

steps.title: Your results
steps.say: Your review shows your score, how you did in each Client Needs area, and every question, so you can study the ones you missed.

tutorials.title: Take an adaptive exam
tutorials.summary: Full-length CAT exams that adapt like test day, and quick adaptive runs with rationales.

steps.title: Switch to exam mode
steps.say: The real NCLEX adapts to you. To practice that, open the Exam Center from the Practice tab and switch to Exam mode.

steps.title: Turn on Adaptive
steps.say: Turn on Adaptive CAT. Each question is now chosen from how you're doing, and the mix follows the NCLEX Client Needs blueprint.

steps.title: How it ends
steps.say: With 150 questions selected, the exam ends as soon as your result is clear, after at least 85 questions, just like test day.

steps.title: Start the exam
steps.say: Tap Start exam.

steps.title: Up to 150
steps.say: The counter says up to 150, because the exam may finish sooner. Answer each question and tap Next.

steps.title: End early
steps.say: You can stop a practice exam at any time with the End exam button, then review what you've answered.

steps.title: Quick adaptive run
steps.say: For a shorter adaptive run, tap CAT Exam on the Home tab. It lasts 20 to 75 questions and explains every answer as you go.

steps.title: Learn as you go
steps.say: Submit each answer to see whether you were right and why, then tap Continue. The level at the top shows how hard your questions are getting.

tutorials.title: Find your weak areas
tutorials.summary: Use analytics and exam reviews to see where you lose points, then practice exactly those.

steps.title: Open Analytics
steps.say: Analytics shows where you stand. Open it from the Practice tab.

steps.title: Overall accuracy
steps.say: At the top is your overall accuracy. Scores use Next Gen partial credit, so seventy percent is a reasonable readiness benchmark.

steps.title: Your pace
steps.say: Your pace shows how long you usually take per question, against the exam's budget of about two minutes. It breaks your time down by question type, and warns you when rushed answers are costing you points.

steps.title: Weakest topics
steps.say: Weakest topics lists the areas where you're losing the most points.

steps.title: Every breakdown
steps.say: Keep scrolling for your accuracy by Client Needs, by clinical judgment step, by category and by topic.

steps.title: Exam history
steps.say: Exam history lists every session you've finished. Tap one to review it.

steps.title: Filter to your misses
steps.say: Under Review questions, switch the filter to Incorrect, then tap a question.

steps.title: Study the rationale
steps.say: You'll see your answer marked right or wrong, with the full rationale. Use the arrows at the top to step through your misses.

steps.title: Practice weak areas
steps.say: Back in Analytics, Practice weak areas opens the Exam Center with a question pool weighted toward the topics you miss most.

tutorials.title: Work through a case study
tutorials.summary: Read the client's chart and answer six clinical judgment questions as the case unfolds.

steps.title: Open case studies
steps.say: Next Gen NCLEX case studies follow one client through six questions. Open NGN Case Studies from the Practice tab.

steps.title: Choose a case
steps.say: Each case shows its subject. Let's open Postoperative Sepsis.

steps.title: Read the chart
steps.say: The client's chart is pinned at the top. Switch between tabs, like Vital Signs and Labs, to find the cues.

steps.title: Clinical judgment steps
steps.say: The label above the question shows which clinical judgment step it tests. The first step is Recognize Cues.

steps.title: Answer step one
steps.say: Select every finding that needs follow-up, then submit and read the rationale.

steps.title: The case unfolds
steps.say: Tap Next question. As the case unfolds, you'll use the same chart to analyze what the cues mean.

steps.title: Answer step two
steps.say: This step is a matrix. For each finding, decide whether it's an expected part of recovery or a sign of infection.

steps.title: Make room
steps.say: Tap the arrow beside the chart tabs to collapse the chart when you need more room. Tap any tab to open it again.

tutorials.title: Learn drugs with visual cards
tutorials.summary: Search the drug library, color the mechanism drawing, and quiz yourself.

steps.title: Open the drug library
steps.say: Visual drug cards are on the Learn tab. Tap Visual Drug Cards.

steps.title: Filter or search
steps.say: Filter the library by body system with the chips, or search by generic name, brand name or drug class.

steps.title: Open a card
steps.say: Tap a drug to open its card.

steps.title: One layout for every drug
steps.say: Every card follows the same layout: the name and class, its uses, a quick tip, how to give it, and its side effects as icons.

steps.title: Color the drawing
steps.say: The drawing animates how the drug works. Pick a color, then tap a part of the drawing.

steps.title: Answer the recall question
steps.say: Each part asks you a recall question. Think of your answer first, then tap Reveal answer.

steps.title: Check yourself
steps.say: Compare your answer, then tap Got it. Coloring every part is a memorable way to lock in how the drug works.

steps.title: Nursing considerations
steps.say: Scroll down for a simplified explanation and the nursing considerations you need for the exam.

steps.title: Quiz yourself
steps.say: Tap Quiz me on this drug. You'll see a mechanism and its side effects, and pick which drug it is.

steps.title: Master each drug
steps.say: A correct answer marks the drug as mastered in your library. Tap Next drug to keep going.

tutorials.title: Practice in the simulation labs
tutorials.summary: Calculate drip rates, sequence procedures, and read live heart rhythms.

steps.title: Nine hands-on labs
steps.say: The Simulate tab has nine hands-on labs. A green badge appears beside each lab you complete.

steps.title: IV drip rate
steps.say: In the IV Drip Rate Lab, read the provider's order and work out the drops per minute.

steps.title: Set the rate
steps.say: Type your answer and tap Set rate. The drip chamber runs at whatever rate you enter, so you can watch your answer work.

steps.title: Skills lab
steps.say: The Skills Lab turns procedures into sequences. Pick one, like Donning PPE.

steps.title: Tap the steps in order
steps.say: Tap each step in the correct order. A wrong tap shakes, so you learn the sequence by doing it.

steps.title: Name the rhythm
steps.say: The ECG Rhythm Trainer shows a live monitor strip. First, name the rhythm.

steps.title: Choose the priority action
steps.say: Then choose the priority nursing action. The correct answer turns green, and the voice guide explains why.

steps.title: More labs to explore
steps.say: There's plenty more to practice: insulin mixing, blood gases, chest tubes, fetal monitoring, vital signs triage and hypoglycemia rescue.

tutorials.title: Flashcards, lab values and guides
tutorials.summary: Quick-review tools for the facts you need to know cold.

steps.title: Flashcard decks
steps.say: On the Learn tab, open Flashcards. Each deck covers a high-yield topic, like antidotes, lab values or isolation precautions.

steps.title: Flip a card
steps.say: Open a deck, then tap the card to flip it and check your answer.

steps.title: Sort what you know
steps.say: Tap Got it if you knew it, or Still learning to keep that card in your review pool.

steps.title: Lab values
steps.say: Lab Values is a visual reference for normal ranges. Tap any value to read its nursing note.

steps.title: Study guides
steps.say: Further down the Learn tab are study guides for every subject. The speaker button on each section reads it aloud.

steps.title: Dynamic drills
steps.say: For calculation practice, open Dynamic Drills on the Practice tab. The numbers change every time, so you can't just memorize answers.

steps.title: Drill until it's automatic
steps.say: Answer, submit, and keep going until the math becomes automatic.
